description:
We are seeking a Junior Software Developer for one of our  PRIME CONTRACTS  and offers exciting opportunities to support essential services and mission critical activities across the enterprise. Our mission supports the Government Corporate Management Services (CMS) by providing full life cycle support services through the sustainment, modernization, and transformation of the enterprise corporate applications. These applications are used across the government enterprise and are critical to the daily functions of thousands of users across acquisition, business, finance, HR, training, recruitment, program management, security, logistics and more. Come join our diverse and growing team with lots of opportunities!   

 
 Join an established, high-performing team responsible for the sustainment, enhancement, and modernization of mission-critical security applications that support essential operational functions across the enterprise. 

 Contribute to the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of modern front-end applications utilizing technologies such as JavaScript, AngularJS, Vue.js, and Node.js. Collaborate with developers, technical leads, and stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-focused solutions.

 Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, troubleshooting, deployment, and production support. Help identify opportunities to improve system functionality, performance, and user experience.

 Work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment where you will be challenged to solve complex technical problems, implement system enhancements, and support modernization initiatives that directlyimpactmission success.

 Take ownership of assigned tasks and projects while balancing independent work with collaboration across cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable contributing both as an individual contributor and as a valued member of a larger development team.

 Engage with technical leads and team members to evaluate emerging technologies, improve development practices, and support the ongoing evolution of critical sustainment systems.

 
 Required Qualifications: 

 
 An active security clearance with polygraph. 

 A bachelor's degree in a technical discipline and three (3) years of experience in software development/engineering. Seven (7) years of experience in software development/engineering may be substituted in lieu of a degree.  

 Experience working with front-end technologies including JavaScript   

 Willingness to learn new technologies 

 Experience developing and updating technical documentation 

 
 Technology stack: 

 
 JavaScript  

 Node.js   

 AngularJS   

 Elastic Search   

 Vue.js   

 MongoDB   

 AWS   

 Git 

 
 Desired Qualifications: 

 
 Experience working with the AWS Platform 

 Experience working in an Agile Development Team 

 Experience working with Git for source code management 

 Experience with Node.js, AngularJS, Angular, VueJS  or comparable JavaScript frameworks/libraries 

 Experience with GOTS products   

 Experience with EngineX   

 
 The estimated salary range for this position is between $130,000-$150,000 (annualized USD). This range reflects the typical pay for the role and is one part of the company's comprehensive compensation package. Actual salaries are influenced by several factors, such as location, the individual’s education, skills, experience, and competencies, as well as contract affordability and organizational needs. 
  

 What’s in It for You? 

 Flexible work environment

 A team mentality – work with friendly, like-minded professionals

 Work with innovative, cutting edge technologies

 Enjoy extremely competitive compensation and benefits

 A work-life balance you can count on

 Opportunities to grow and advance your career on our dime

  

 The Benefits You Get with Freedom 

 Amazing benefits including matching 401k, fully paid medical, and more

 Generous paid time off – including paid site closure days

 Competitive salary offerings

 Paid training and tuition reimbursement

 Referral bonuses

 Fully paid life and disability

 Annual logo wear allowance

 Company sponsored events (game nights, holiday party, summer party, happy hours)

 Interested in learning more about Freedom and our culture?  Contact us today!  We’re constantly hosting hiring events in our office and elsewhere, to help you get a sense of what life is like at Freedom before joining the team.

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability or veteran status
